units.source_text: 头中将听了这话，点头称是，接着说道：“

en.t: To no Chujo heard this, nodded in agreement, and went on to say, "

units.source_text: 如今有这样的事，女子真心爱慕男子的俊秀与温柔，

en.t: These days such things happen: a woman sincerely admires a man's good looks and gentleness,

units.source_text: 而男子有不可信赖的嫌疑，这就成了一大问题。

en.t: but if the man seems unreliable, it becomes a serious problem.

units.source_text: 这时候女子认为只要自己没有过失，宽恕丈夫的轻薄行为，

en.t: At such a time, the woman thinks that as long as she herself is not at fault, if she forgives her husband's frivolous conduct,

units.source_text: 不久丈夫自必回心转意。

en.t: before long her husband will surely change his heart.
But in reality it is not so.

units.source_text: 那么只有这样：即使丈夫有违心的行为，

en.t: Then there is only this: even if the husband acts against her wishes,

units.source_text: 女子惟有忍气吞声，此外没有别的办法了。”

en.t: the woman can only swallow her anger in silence; there is no other way."

units.source_text: 说到这里，他想起自己的妹妹葵姬恰恰符合此种情况；

en.t: Having said this much, he remembered that his own sister, Lady Aoi, fit just such a situation;

units.source_text: 但见源氏公子闭目假寐，并不做声，自觉扫兴，心中好不怏怏。

en.t: but seeing Prince Genji with his eyes closed, pretending to doze and saying nothing, he felt the mood had been spoiled and was deeply displeased.
